response: Neuriy AI is Neuriy's chat product. Replies are powered by ElloFive (Ello5), Neuriy's own model — with IDHook login and the Neuriy Marketplace for apps/tools.

Ello5 continuous learning runs day and night on the Neuriy server: it pulls Hugging Face datasets, merges thumbs-up chat feedback, rebuilds a knowledge bank the bridge loads automatically, and can run LoRA fine-tunes when a GPU is available.

Open the Marketplace page inside Neuriy Chat (/marketplace). It lists apps from the Neuriy-Marketplace API. Developers upload tools on the storefront; after approval, ElloFive can search and open them.
